patch_description: This approach replaces the full K8 complete graph of CZ gates with a K4,4 bipartite graph entangler. We partition the 8 qubits into two sets of 4 and connect them using four perfect matchings. This reduces the number of two-qubit gates per block from 28 to 16, significantly lowering the circuit depth and overall gate count, while still maintaining high connectivity and expressive power. The parameter count remains at a highly efficient 3 parameters per block, utilizing collective RY, RZ, and RX rotations to maintain permutation symmetry and aggregate gradients effectively. This lower depth is expected to improve parameter efficiency and execution speed without sacrificing training or generalization performance.
